plugin.name: Jujutsu VCS Integration
plugin.description:
Native IntelliJ integration for Jujutsu (jj), a Git-compatible version control system with a fundamentally different approach to working with code.

Why Jujutsu?

Jujutsu treats your working copy as a commit—always. No staging area, no "dirty" state. Just describe what you're working on and keep coding.

Key Features

  • Describe-First Workflow — Working Copy tool window for describing current work and creating new changes.
  • Custom Log View — Visual commit graph with inline change IDs, descriptions, and bookmarks.
  • Change Operations — Edit, abandon, and describe changes directly from the log.
  • File History & Annotations — Full file history with diff viewer and line-by-line blame.
  • Multi-Repository Support — Work with multiple JJ repositories in a single project.
  • Real-Time Status — Auto-refresh keeps the UI in sync as you edit files.

GitHub · Issues
plugin.change-notes:
0.8.15

Added

  • A new "Set Diff Base" quick action (VCS main menu → Jujutsu, and Jujutsu → Set Diff Base in the editor's right-click menu) for switching what editor gutter markers and Annotate compare against, without a trip to Settings — pick "Working copy parent", "Latest immutable ancestor (trunk)", "Previous commit (grandparent)", type a custom revset expression, or pin to any specific revision via a search popup. It writes the same setting as the Settings → Version Control → Jujutsu → Diff Base row, so the two never disagree. ([#43](https://github.com/kkkev/jj-idea/issues/43))
  • "Undo..." and "Set Diff Base" are now grouped under a "Jujutsu" submenu in the VCS main menu, in the same section as the "Git" submenu, instead of sitting as separate top-level items — "Initialise Jujutsu Repository" stays where it already was, alongside Git/Mercurial/Subversion's own "init" actions.
  • The Diff Base setting (Settings → Version Control → Jujutsu, and the new quick action above) gained a fourth option, "Previous commit (grandparent)" — the commit before your last one, or trunk if you're right above it. ([#43](https://github.com/kkkev/jj-idea/issues/43))
  • Settings → Version Control → Jujutsu's "Installation Help" now tells you when your jj is too old for a plugin feature (e.g. Advance Bookmark, which needs jj 0.39+), listing exactly which one(s) and switching straight to the matching upgrade command — no separate section to find, and it stays out of your way entirely when your jj already supports everything.
  • The log's Root filter can now exclude a repository, not just include one: click a root once to show only it, click again to hide just that one and show everything else, click a third time to clear it. A new "Select All"/"Select None" option at the top of the filter bulk-selects every root. Handy when you have many repositories open and only want to mute a couple of noisy ones rather than picking every other repo by hand. ([#96](https://github.com/kkkev/jj-idea/issues/96))

    • Fixed

  • The Describe dialog's prompt now shows the short change id (matching the id shown everywhere else in the UI) instead of the full 64-character id. ([#76](https://github.com/kkkev/jj-idea/issues/76))
  • Split's per-file preview no longer shows the same content on both sides for a fully-ticked file: the right-hand "Child" pane now actually shows the child's content, matching its title, instead of duplicating the parent side and appearing to show no changes at all. ([#101](https://github.com/kkkev/jj-idea/issues/101))
  • Settings → Version Control → Jujutsu no longer shows a horizontal scrollbar in a multi-repo project with a per-repository diff-base override set.
  • The Installation Help section's command labels ("Homebrew:", "Cargo:", etc.) now have a comfortable gap before their command box instead of sitting flush against it, and several rows across the page take up less minimum width, reducing the chance of a horizontal scrollbar in a narrower Settings window.
  • The status bar working-copy widget no longer grows to fill the whole status bar and crowd out other widgets when the current change has a very long description — it now ellipsizes to a sensible width, shrinking further on a narrow window, with the full description still available in its tooltip. ([#95](https://github.com/kkkev/jj-idea/issues/95))
  • The status bar working-copy widget and the bookmark widget's status-bar fallback now match the padding, text colour, and hover/pressed highlight of every other status bar widget, instead of using their own slightly-off colours — including a case where the highlight could get stuck on permanently after the first hover. ([#95](https://github.com/kkkev/jj-idea/issues/95))
  • The Working Copy tool window sometimes started up with an empty description box and every toolbar button greyed out, recovering only after the next change to the working copy. Also, disabling the description box (e.g. while no repository is selected) now actually makes it read-only, instead of silently accepting typing that went nowhere.
  • The bookmark toolbar widget and both status bar widgets no longer show up in projects that aren't Jujutsu repositories — they used to appear (as an empty, non-functional widget) in any project as soon as the plugin was installed. They now also appear immediately after running Jujutsu → Init, without needing to restart the IDE. ([#100](https://github.com/kkkev/jj-idea/issues/100))
  • Fetching from a remote could log a "Write-unsafe context!" IDE error and, more importantly, silently skip saving your edited files before the jj command ran, so it could operate on stale on-disk content — a regression from an earlier fix for a shutdown hang. Saving is now legal again in all cases, and a modal dialog still can't block indefinitely while it waits. ([#106](https://github.com/kkkev/jj-idea/issues/106))
  • "Move Bookmark Here..." and "Move Bookmark to Change..." no longer open with OK greyed out when a valid destination is already selected — the OK button now reflects the pre-selected row immediately, instead of only updating after you change the selection or tick "Allow backwards or sideways move". ([#105](https://github.com/kkkev/jj-idea/issues/105))
  • Settings → Version Control → Jujutsu now shows the identity actually in effect for each repository — including one set by a jj config scope (e.g. `--when.repositories`) — and no longer prompts to configure an identity a scope already supplies. The global "User Identity" fields now read and write the same (user-level) scope, instead of showing a merged value they couldn't actually update. ([#89](https://github.com/kkkev/jj-idea/issues/89))
  • The log's right-click menu, the bookmark widget dropdown, and the bookmarks panel's `@` node now say "Advance Bookmark to Working Copy" instead of "Advance Bookmark Here" — in a per-row menu, "Here" read as "move the bookmark to this row," but the action always advances the nearest bookmark to your current working copy, never to the clicked row. ([#104](https://github.com/kkkev/jj-idea/issues/104))

    • See full release notes for details.
